name: cornell-builder
description: Deploy Cornell AWS infrastructure from plain language. Wraps the builder-mcp server: search the blueprint catalog, open a registration PR, and watch the deploy chain — with governance invariants that never merge, push, or call CloudFormation directly.

github_token.title: GitHub token (optional)
github_token.description: OPTIONAL. Leave blank to install and demo — the blueprint catalog is read anonymously from the public repo. Supply a fine-grained PAT with repo scope for two things only: (1) headroom, since anonymous GitHub API access allows roughly six catalog searches per hour per IP, and (2) real pull requests — without a token every write tool returns a dry-run plan instead of opening a PR.

github_org.title: GitHub organization
github_org.description: Org that owns the workshop repo the catalog is read from and pull requests are opened against. Change this to your own username to rehearse against a fork.

workshop_repo.title: Workshop repository name
workshop_repo.description: Repository the pipeline tracks. Paired with the organization above.

aws_region.title: AWS region
aws_region.description: Region used when reading stack status and pipeline health. Read-only AWS access is enough; the server never creates, updates, or deletes a stack.
